About us

Turning blueprints into landmarks

REVIX is a trailblazing force in development, construction and civil contracting. We deliver residential, commercial and industrial buildings, backed by a passionate team of seasoned engineers.

From our roots in residential contracting to commercial and hospitality turnkey contracts, each structure tells a story of precision and dedication. REVIX is the mother firm of Dynamic Construction Company (DCC Group) and Krishna Engineering.

Headquartered in Ahmedabad, with a team of 42, more than half of them engineers.

01

Our vision

To revolutionize construction by automating the contracting process, where efficiency, precision and innovation converge in every build.

02

Our mission

To elevate construction standards: excellence with integrity, shorter timelines through automation, and spaces that inspire and endure.

03

Why REVIX

Quality assurance, proven expertise, trusted consultants and timely delivery, from planning to project completion.
